subject: Private deployment pricing — environment split & unit economics target
messages:
From: Julian Lowe <julian@healthtech.io>
To: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: procurement@healthtech.io, Maya Chen <maya.chen@healthtech.io>
Date: 2026-09-28T16:12:00-07:00
Subject: Private deployment initial numbers & clarification needed

Hi Monica,

Thanks for the demo today — the team was impressed with the latency controls and the rollout tooling. We discussed a few high-level numbers and I wanted to formalize them so your team can sketch pricing options for VPC/on-prem. Key items we committed to from our side: 

- Expected steady-state token volume: ~250M tokens/month (chat + system prompts).
- Peak burst: up to ~1B tokens in a big campaign month (approx 4x steady).
- Environments: prod + staging + sandbox (3 distinct environments); sandbox used by partners with limited capacity.
- SLO expectations: 95th pct latency under 250ms for critical routes.

Budget guidance from procurement: target total cost of ownership (licensing + support + infra) under $12K/month for the steady-state load, or roughly targeting $/1M tokens in the low hundreds — they asked us to surface unit economics.

Can you confirm whether Redwood’s private licensing can do a per-environment unit price (we'd prefer a blended monthly license covering the three envs) and what support tiers map to faster incident SLAs (SLA-backed response vs standard business-hours)? Attaching a high-level bill-of-materials and PoC scope.

Appreciate a short recap and next steps — procurement wants a two-page executive summary they can share with finance.

Best,
Julian Lowe
Head of Platform Integrations
HealthTech Inc.

Attachments: HealthTech_BoM_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), PoC_scope_and_milestones.pdf (PDF)

From: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
To: Julian Lowe <julian@healthtech.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-28T18:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment initial numbers & clarification needed

Julian — thanks for the clear write-up and the attachments. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap of ask (short):
- Validate Feasible Licensing Options: monthly blended vs per-env SKU.
- Support tiers: clarify response times, included runbooks, and optional 24x7 on-call add-on.
- Unit economics: provide a target $/1M tokens band for steady-state and a model for burst/overage handling.
- PoC scoping: confirm environment count and minimal infra footprint for the PoC.

Answers / notes:
- Licensing: we can offer a blended Private license that covers multiple environments under a single contract (recommended for ease) or per-environment SKUs if you need chargebacks per team. Blended license typically has a base platform fee + token consumption band pricing.
- Support tiers: Standard (business hours, 8x5), Enhanced (24x7 monitoring + 2-hour incident response), and Enterprise Premium (SLA-backed 1-hour response + designated TAM). Pricing deltas: Enhanced ~ +20% of base license, Enterprise Premium ~ +45%. We’ll share exact numbers in the summary.
- Unit economics: for the steady-state ~250M tokens/mo we can target a blended unit price in the range $80–$160 per 1M tokens depending on quantization/quant profiles and caching/batching assumptions. To hit the procurement target near the low hundreds per 1M, we’ll need to assume aggressive prefix caching and the Minimal-Latency compute profile (higher infra cost).
- Burst handling: we support burst capacity with an overage multiplier or pre-bought burst credits; bursts beyond reserved capacity billed at 1.5–2x baseline unit price.

Next steps (I propose):
1) Aditya to produce a 2-page executive summary for procurement with 3 pricing scenarios (blended, per-env SKU, and blended + premium SLA).
2) Rishi to create a quick PoC sizing estimate (GPU hours, persistent KV cache sizing) for prod+staging+sandbox.
3) Julian to confirm whether sandbox must support partner API keys (affects isolation and licensing).

Can we aim to share the executive summary by 2026-09-30 EOD PT? If that works I'll route internal docs and a quick spreadsheet.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Julian Lowe <julian@healthtech.io>

Date: 2026-09-29T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Private deployment initial numbers & clarification needed

Monica / Aditya — that timeline is tight but feasible. A few clarifications from procurement & engineering: 

- Sandbox isolation: must support team-level API keys and separate rate limits (we cannot share prod prefixes with partners).
- Budget nuance: procurement says $12K/mo is an aspirational cap — finance wants to see a realistic baseline + one optimistic (with heavy caching) and one conservative (no caching) scenario.
- PoC duration: 6 weeks preferred, but procurement will consider 3 if the POCs clearly demonstrate the latency SLOs on a scaled sample.

If you can do the 2-page summary with those three scenarios and include a one-line risk callout for each (what would push us north of $12K), we'll be able to push this to finance quickly.

Thanks,
Julian

On Tue, Sep 28, 2026 at 6:03 PM Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com> wrote:

From: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
To: Julian Lowe <julian@healthtech.io>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com, rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-09-30T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Private deploy executive summary + next steps (attached)

Julian / team — attached is the 2-page executive summary and a short pricing spreadsheet. Quick highlights inline: 

- Scenario A (Optimistic — aggressive caching + quantized model):
  - Steady-state blended cost: $9,600/month (~$38.4 per 1M tokens after factoring applied prefix caching on 250M tokens).
  - Risk: caching assumptions require <30% unique prefix variance.

- Scenario B (Baseline — moderate caching + standard quant):
  - Steady-state blended cost: $12,800/month (~$51.2 per 1M tokens).
  - Risk: higher model memory needs if average sequence length increases.

- Scenario C (Conservative — minimal caching, reserved infra for peaks):
  - Steady-state blended cost: $18,400/month (~$73.6 per 1M tokens).
  - Risk: spikes and partner traffic may drive up burst billing.

Support tiers and recommended fit:
- For a production deployment with partner-facing sandbox, we recommend Enhanced support for initial go-live and Enterprise Premium by steady-state.

PoC ask:
- Provide access to prod-like sandbox with dedicated API keys (fits partner needs).
- PoC sizing estimate attached (Rishi) — recommends 2x T4-equivalent nodes for prod, 1x for staging, small sandbox.

Next steps:
1) Julian — confirm sandbox partner requirement and preferred PoC length (3 vs 6 weeks).
2) Procurement — confirm whether a blended invoice is acceptable or if you need per-env chargebacks.
3) Redwood — prepare contract draft and support add-on pricing once sandbox decision is confirmed.

Attachments: Redwood_HealthTech_ExecSummary_20260930.pdf, pricing_breakdown_20260930.xlsx

Cheers,
Monica Patel
Enterprise Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
